data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Lykos Line Shifts as Main Fronts Cool
previous_model_summary.war_summary: Since the previous edition, Lykos Isle has moved to a four-base Warden, three-base Colonial balance, with two ownership events in the latest two hours and fighting still brisk on both casualty ledgers. Fisherman’s Row, formerly the busiest fresh front, has recorded no new movement in that window; its contested board remains six Colonial bases to three Warden, though 20 events mark it as the day’s most active ledger. Linn Mercy retains all 11 bases under Warden control but leads the field with 32 events over 24 hours, while the latest two-hour lull contrasts with heavy earlier losses. Stonecradle has likewise gone quiet recently after 12 daily events and remains entirely Warden-held. Deadlands continues as a divided and exceptionally costly sector—four Warden bases against seven Colonial—with seven ownership events and renewed enlistment activity. Stlican Shelf, eight Warden to one Colonial, saw six daily events but none in the latest six hours. The great casualty mills of Weathered Expanse, Clahstra, and Loch Mor remain active in manpower terms, yet show no fresh base movement in the latest two-hour report.
